# Vendored: svg-credit-card-payment-icons

Third-party artwork. Not covered by this project's AGPLv3 license; retains its own.

- Source: `flat-rounded` set of https://github.com/aaronfagan/svg-credit-card-payment-icons
- Fetched: 2026-09-24 from the `main` branch
- License: Apache-2.0, full text in `LICENSE` in this directory

## Files

- `visa.svg`, `mastercard.svg`, `amex.svg`, `discover.svg` - unmodified copies of
  the upstream `flat-rounded/<brand>.svg` files.

The card network names and logos are trademarks of their respective owners and are
shown only to indicate which payment cards checkout accepts.
